items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: And George, the judge then, Fred.

ctx.x: Tom Miller. She had two brothers, Henry and Tom Miller. And Mr. Tom had three children, Miss Grace and Tom and Annie. And they were called Grace King Miller. Oh, yes. I've heard that name. I'm wondering if you... And George, the judge then, Fred.
You told me about the people, this lady that you worked for at Tulane or Newcomb College. One time she found you reading some books she didn't like.
